name: section-depth-limit
body: No template composition chain may be deeper than six heading levels (`#` through `######`): heading depth is nesting depth, so a section at depth n has children at depth n+1 only, and the depth is bounded by the content syntax, not a setting. A template set whose composition depth exceeds six is refused at load with a templates error path-qualified to the offending `template.yaml` (templates-dir-validation step 4).
